acceptanceCriteria: The S5a failure-mode summary states that unsupported-structural-runtime applies only to maps requiring a structural mechanical proof.
The S5a summary distinguishes verify.Stable accepting ABSENT from VerifyStableUniverse requiring EXACT and rejecting ABSENT; regenerate requirement line references if edits shift them.
body: Confirmed documentation mismatch in round 2 review of a8c05c4f45a8971665ee97d2eada7c739a0e0d14..801d33251d509f29ad589100bf0a25c2d758c2cf (V1-0632 S5a). docs/specs/cem-stable-v1.md:446-448 claims every runtime outside structural tuples refuses, and attributes every missing committed sidecar refusal to the verifier. Actual: internal/cem/verify/stable.go:189 guards runtime admission with structural; stable.go:285 initializes ABSENT without rejecting it. internal/lrfrepo/adapter.go:373 rejects non-EXACT. Build log correctly qualifies the non-structural fixture but the spec summary remains inaccurate. Expected: spec describes these exact boundaries. Review severity P3; no admission bypass. Installed Core 1.0.0-rc.3 build 407; verification runtime go1.27.2 darwin. Static reproduction: compare the cited conditions against the summary. No product change or extra benchmark required.

completion.reason: S5a spec failure-mode summary qualified: unsupported-structural-runtime applies only to maps needing a structural mechanical proof, and the summary distinguishes the verifier accepting ABSENT from VerifyStableUniverse requiring EXACT (excluded-artifact-mismatch). REQUIREMENTS.tsv regenerated. Codex round 2 PASS. Delivered in beamfall/corvint#817, merged to main at 9495d8b44. Tests on go1.27.2: receiptbundle, cem/..., lrfrepo, lrf, witness, witnesscollapse, console, conformance/ocm-v0, filtered doccorpus and cmd/corvint PASS; go vet clean; doc gates PASS; CEM check and seal PASS. full-gate (make gate) NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference). Evidence: sha256 of the lane build-log record at the merge commit.
